scope: Direct order-800 representative orbit checks; no interpolation or new DYNAMITE runs.
statistics_scope: All 50,000 samples; raw intrinsic normalized histograms/moments, before spatial symmetries, counter-rotation, or observational projection.
timing_scope: Synchronized whole production solve including sampling and energy diagnostics; excludes statistics and artifact I/O. First calls may reuse earlier compiled kernels; warm repeats are separate. Process peak RSS is cumulative, not per-orbit or device memory.
